name: SVW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Crowned in a sixteen-man Inaugural Tournament across three rounds in a single week, decided when a distracted referee let a set of brass knuckles change hands mid-match.

name: SVW Bunkhouse Championship
epitaph: A no-disqualification, specialty-matches-only title, its inaugural tournament run back-to-back with the Heavyweight tournament inside the same week.

name: SVW Alabama Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The federation's regional singles title, its first champion crowned when a missed top-rope splash cost the round's best-worked wrestler the fall.

name: SVW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Won when a distraction from the losing team's own manager let a handful of tights decide the inaugural final.

name: SVW Alabama Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Announced in the federation's own founding title list alongside its four sister championships; no tournament or title change for it survives in the held record.
